findings.sms_ascii_vs_ui_unicode_masking: Identified critical rationale for omnichannel SMS masking: UI uses unicode bullets ('•') for high-aesthetic clinical presentation, while SMS/messenger channels use ASCII asterisks ('*') to avoid switching SMS encoding to UCS-2 Unicode (which cuts segment size from 160 to 70 characters and doubles clinic SMS costs). Both modes are now cleanly unified in maskRussianPhone.
